name: Alpengarten Kitzbühel
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpine Flower Garden on the Kitzbüheler Horn at 1,880 metres displays over 400 high-alpine plant species from across the globe against iconic mountain peaks.
preis: Admission to the garden is free; cable car ticket or mountain toll applies
oeffnungszeiten: Open early June to early October during cable car operating hours
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Alpine Flower Garden Kitzbühel (Alpenblumengarten Kitzbüheler Horn), perched at an impressive elevation of 1,880 metres on the southern flank of the iconic Kitzbüheler Horn, ranks among the most breathtaking botanical high-altitude sanctuaries in the Alps. Spanning over 20,000 square metres of carefully curated slopes, the garden showcases more than 400 distinct species of alpine plants, blossoms, and shrubs hailing from diverse mountain chains across the globe. Alongside legendary native alpine flora—including velvety edelweiss, blue gentians, mountain arnica, and vibrant alpine roses—visitors can admire rare high-altitude specimens from the Caucasus, the Pyrenees, the Andes, and the Himalayas. Conceived by dedicated botanists, this showcase reveals how delicate vegetation masters extreme climatic survival strategies, all framed by an astonishing 360-degree panorama of the Wilder Kaiser, the Hohe Tauern, and glaciated ridges.

Route & Anforderungen

Visiting the botanical reserve is easily paired with a scenic ascent on the Kitzbüheler Horn cable cars. From the mountain station of the Horn summit lift or the Alpenhaus mid-station, marked pedestrian footpaths descend gently in ten minutes to the garden gate. Inside, winding gravel switchbacks, stone steps, and timber viewing bridges escort guests through varied micro-habitats and altitude zones. Comprehensive informative plaques catalog plant species, bloom calendars, medicinal folklore, and botanical origins. Exploring the gardens thoroughly takes approximately one to two hours. Given the mountain slope and natural stone steps, paths are not wheelchair accessible; surefootedness and sturdy walking shoes with reliable rubber tread are recommended.

Besuch & Anreise

Access is effortlessly achieved via the Kitzbüheler Hornbahnen gondola network starting from Kitzbühel town directly to the Alpenhaus or the Horn summit. Free parking is available at the valley station. Alternatively, drivers can ascend the scenic Kitzbüheler Horn Panorama Toll Road up to the Alpenhaus terminal. Rail travelers alight at Kitzbühel main station and walk just ten minutes to the gondola valley terminal. Admission into the botanical garden is free of charge.

Tipps

The zenith of botanical color occurs during June and July, when entire mountain slopes burst into deep magenta alpine rose blossoms and cobalt gentians blanket the rock terraces. Pair your botanical walk with a relaxed lunch on the sun terrace of the historic Alpenhaus lodge or hike to the very top of the horn to inspect the iconic broadcasting tower.
